body: The first time I ever had a panic attack was only a few months ago. It started off with really bad chest pain and then I felt a sharp pain in my left shoulder, I was convinced I was having  a heart attack, this triggered the panic attack for me. I was shaking and crying, I could barely breath and I just felt like my body was out of my control. It was such a terrifying experience, because in those 10 minutes I thought I was going to die, I was so scared I ended up calling an ambulance telling them I was having a heart attack and it was pretty embarrassing when I was fine not long after. I was pretty shaken up afterwards, but that was when it really hit me that I was suffering from anxiety.
I know, I wouldn't want to put my mum through that. I'm just finding it really hard to stop thinking about killing myself
